featured_reviews.name: Sourav Bhattacharjee
featured_reviews.review_text:
WORST PARLOUR YOU CAN EVER VISIT AFTER OVER PAYING FOR ALL THE PACKAGES

First of all, I would like to address this to all the people reading this, that I am not the kind of person who has problem with everything and takes social media to vent the anger and write a bad review. Honestly, I do not post reviews until its very good or extremely bad. But my wife's experience with this parlour forced me to do it. This was the worst experience she have ever had at a parlour! I am writing this review behalf of her as a warning to other sisters not to waste your hard-earned money and your beauty at this parlour.

Now starting with the review while going through my friends place we came across this parlour advertisement for hair cutting, waxing and all beauty care with an exciting offers which was displayed outside the parlour with a standee. My wife was planning to go for it for a long time and so we decided to go visit them. My wife and my bhabhi opted for the package which had waxing, threading, clean up, pre - post wash, hair spa and haircut.

They did not took the appointment as there was no such thing required and once they reached on the parlour, surprisingly it was no where like the one that they saw on there google. It was such a tiny space with hardly space to keep four chairs. Anyways they told the manager about the package and they were asked them to wait for 30-60 mins.

Although they were not very happy with the parlour owner behavior but still they said ok and went out to kill the time. They called them after 30 min and they said it’s still not vacant. Ahhhh finally after 45 mins they asked them to come for the treatment. To there surprise the whole salon was filled with fumes of keratin treatment since it is a very small space and above all there was no AC since they had some issues with the AC. Okay understood these things can happen. Anyways they spend more than 4 hours in that room without any AC or fan.(They had to literally ask for water since the parlour persons even did not have courtesy to offer them even water after making them wait for like 45 mins.).

Anyhow the treatment was started and when they asked for the rate of packages then they denied about the offers as the owner told that it is just to attract the customers as the packages was 2 years old rate. It was ok. Not much to say about the rate. After the half treatment they was encouraged to do the clean up as the parlour executives where not able to wax them up, after multiple tries at the same place blood was bleeding out of my bhabhi's arm and my wife's hand got fully red and it was burning like hell and then they were blaming the customers only as you both are sweating so we are unable to do wax. What you can expect as there was no fan or Ac which were workable. Then the lady manager told them you can leave the wax and continue to do the other treatments like cleanup, spa, hair cutting.

The real problem started when they wish to leave the parlour after paying for how much treatment was done but they were not willing to leave them as started talking like unprofessional. Literally they requested her many times telling her about there problem but the parlour lady was one awful rude lady. They were in tears after her wax treatment and insensitive behavior. However they left them once my wife called me up over there as the situation was getting worst.

I would like to add that she was not giving the treatment for free. They already had paid for the package and after getting money you people treat your customers as beggars. You can make customers wait for hours, it's okay and after that there is no hospitality like no fans or AC and also they were not knowing how to wax as they are now suffering with folliculitis and then they went to another parlour and had ice pack first and then completed all the treatments smoothly.
I REPEAT NEVER VISIT THIS PLACE.

Whether you’re looking for a subtle glow-up or a total transformation, a new look is the ultimate mood booster. Book your Hair Appointment Today!

Ready to step into the new year with a fresh vibe? These 2026 hair trends are taking over, and they’re exactly what you need to upgrade your look and feel like the best version of yourself. From effortless volume to face-framing magic, there’s a style here for everyone!

Book your Hair Appointment Today!
Book your Hair Color Appointment Today!

Deep Mocha Shine at Simone Salon & Spa!

Whether you’re looking to deepen your natural tone or want a complete seasonal shift, this chocolatey hue provides a timeless elegance that catches the light perfectly with every move.

Stop the Stress of Hairfall at Simone Salon & Spa!

Watching your hair thin out can be incredibly draining, but you don't have to just accept it. With our specialized approach, you can start seeing a real difference in less than 21 days for 6 sessions in just 9,999/-.
